title: Support seconds in compact durations and reject malformed input
body: `parse_duration` in `timefmt/durations.py` understands hours and minutes (`"1h30m"`). Please add an `s` unit for seconds, so `"2m15s"` gives 135. Input that is not entirely a sequence of `<number><unit>` parts, such as an empty string, a bare number like `"90"`, an unknown unit like `"5d"` or a trailing number like `"1h30"`, currently returns a partial total silently; it should raise `ValueError` instead.
